answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can earn or attest. Reputation only grows through peer attestations that are themselves staked, so a hollow sock-puppet with no history looks like clean ivory on the surface yet cannot borrow trust. Faking N identities costs N times the bond up front, and every false attestation slashes the faker own stake, sending its reputation into a downward spiral. Attacker cost scales linearly with sybils while an honest agent pays the bond once.
